header.text: Every chemical element is represented by its own symbol. For some elements, that symbol is one capital letter. pieces.text: The
for a molecule contains the symbol for each chemical element in the molecule. Many chemical formulas use subscripts. A
is text that is smaller and placed lower than the normal line of text.
In chemical formulas, the subscripts are numbers. The subscript is always written
the symbol for an element. The subscript tells you how many atoms that symbol represents. If the symbol represents just one atom, then no subscript is included.
